root_idea.summary: A root oriented toward completing, fulfilling, or making something whole, with related uses for rendering what is due in full and taking or receiving something completely.
root_idea.development: The semantic range develops from completion and full attainment to keeping a covenant, giving or receiving a due amount in full, and, in تَوَفَّى, taking a soul fully in death or sleep.

senses.definition: To fulfill or complete fully a required task, undertaking, or obligation.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for carrying out what has been required in full, including the comprehensive fulfillment associated with إبراهيمَ الَّذِي وَفَّى.

senses.definition: To render, pay, give, or deliver something due in full.
senses.usage_conditions: Typically takes a person or beneficiary as well as the due, reward, account, or recompense being rendered; passive forms describe the due being fully paid or received.

senses.definition: To fulfill or keep a covenant, promise, pledge, or other undertaking.
senses.usage_conditions: Used especially with بِـ for fulfilling a covenant or promise and for maintaining it without breach.

senses.definition: To give, supply, or make full the due measure, weight, amount, or payment.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for completing a measured or owed amount, including giving full measure and weight and paying an amount in full.

senses.definition: To take or receive a person or soul fully, especially by causing death; in sleep, to take the soul temporarily.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran uses the form for taking souls in death and for the taking associated with sleep; active and passive constructions describe the taker and the person taken. The lexical sense is full taking, while the context determines whether death or sleep is intended.

senses.definition: To take, exact, or receive something fully or wholly.
senses.usage_conditions: The form emphasizes obtaining the entire amount or object without leaving anything outstanding.
A comparative or superlative adjective, used of faithfulness to a covenant or of reaching the greatest degree of completeness.

senses.definition: One who takes or receives a person or soul fully, especially one who causes death.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic form is an inflected active participle in مُتَوَفِّيكَ. In this expression, the taking is interpreted variously as death or as another complete taking associated with elevation or special selection.

senses.definition: One who renders, pays, or gives something due in full.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence is a suffixed plural form referring to those who will fully render what is due.

senses.definition: One who fulfills or keeps a covenant or undertaking.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence is the masculine plural active participle, used of those who keep their covenant when they make one.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fulfill, keep, or remain faithful to a covenant, compact, or promise.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I, especially in the construction وَفَى بِالعَهْدِ or وَفَى بِالوَعْدِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Faithfulness to an engagement or promise.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal noun denoting faithful adherence to an undertaking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pay or deliver something owed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I with a direct object, distinct from the covenant-keeping construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Complete, full, or reaching the required measure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used adjectivally of something whose amount or measure is complete, such as a full coin or full measure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A faithful person; a fulfiller or keeper of a covenant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The adjective وَفِيُّ العَهْدِ denotes one faithful to a covenant.
Form III in the construction وَافَى بِهِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To look upon, look down upon, or obtain a view of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical construction such as أَوْفَى عَلَيْهِ or أَوْفَى فِيهِ; this is distinct from the Quran-attested covenant and full-payment uses of the same Form IV headword.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To complete a specified number of years of one's age.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical Form X construction used with a stated period of age.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Form I covenant fulfillment and its faithful-person adjective are represented.
The Form I payment use is represented.
Rendering a right or due fully is covered by the Form II Quranic sense.
The Form III bring construction is represented.
The Classical Form IV look or view construction is represented separately.
Taking a soul in death or sleep is represented under the Quranic Form V sense.
Taking or receiving fully is represented under the Quranic Form X sense.
Completing a specified number of years is represented as a Classical Form X meaning.
The faithful or covenant-keeping adjective is represented.

cautions: The interpretation of مُتَوَفِّيكَ in 3:55 is disputed: it is understood by some as taking in death and by others as a non-death taking associated with elevation or special selection.
أَوْفَىٰ occurs in the Quran both as the Form IV verb and as a homographic comparative or superlative adjective; these are separate public forms here.
